typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT StratLevelID, SubscriberId,LoadDate FROM member.StratLevel  sl with (Nolock) left join member.Member me with (nolock)  on sl.MemberID = me.MemberID where sl.LoadDate = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetStratLevelrecordinsertedforlogging
GetStratLevelrecordinsertedforlogging sink(input(
		LoadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SubscriberID as string,
		StratLevelID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		SubscriberID = SubscriberId,
		StratLevelID)) ~> Stratfileloadeddatelogfile
